title: Iris：攀登搜索前沿——大规模搜索智能体的训练与评估
summary: 本文介绍两种搜索智能体Iris-mini和Iris-pro，分别基于35B-A3B和397B-A17B规模训练。通过从网页超链接结构反向构建多跳任务，结合SFT与RL交替训练（SFT-RL climbing），在BrowseComp等基准上取得开源搜索智能体最优成绩。
summary_en: This paper presents Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, using a data pipeline that reverse-constructs multi-hop tasks from web hyperlinks and an SFT-RL climbing procedure. They achieve state-of-the-art results among open-source search agents on benchmarks like BrowseComp.
